meta.title: Magic Resume — an AI-native resume workbench
meta.description: An open-source AI resume workbench. Build a local draft, tailor your experience to a role, review AI proposals, and export your resume.

openSource.title: Built in the open
openSource.desc: The Magic Resume core is MIT-licensed and built with its community. Read the code, file an issue, or star the repo

items.q: Do I need an account to start?
items.a: Yes. Your resumes, revision history, and job profile live in your account, so you can pick up where you left off on any device. Signing up takes one step with an email or a social account.

items.q: What is free, and what is paid?
items.a: The open-source editor is MIT-licensed. You can explore local editing for free. The hosted service offers Free, Pro, and Max plans; current prices, models, and included usage are shown in your account before upgrading.

items.q: Will AI change my resume without asking?
items.a: AI suggestions are shown as proposals for you to review. Accept the changes that match your experience and skip the rest. Always check the final resume before sending it.
In your cloud workspace, tied to your account, so signing in on another device picks up where you left off. You can export a JSON backup at any time to keep a copy of your own.
Export a PDF for applications or a JSON file for backup and reuse. You can continue editing the resume and export another version when you need it.

items.q: Are the previews on this page real AI?
items.a: The previews are interactive examples using sample data. They show how the workbench feels. Start creating to work with your own experience in the app.
